component.name: Armory
component.summary: Track a World of Warcraft account, and replay what it remembers

description.p: Armory is a companion for a World of Warcraft account that has been played for a long time and is about to be played again. It shows every character on the account, and it is built around one problem the existing tools do not address: the account remembers everything, so nothing reads as new.

A run takes a snapshot of what the account already has and measures progress from that point. Where an achievement was earned by a character you have not enrolled, its completion flag will never move again, so Armory works out progress from the things that really are per-character — quests completed, statistics, encounters — instead of reading the flag. Where nothing can measure it, you can mark it done yourself. Where it can never be earned again, Armory says so once and then leaves it out.

Profile data comes from Blizzard's API and is a snapshot taken when a character logs out, never a live view. An optional in-game addon adds what the API has no endpoint for: currencies, the Warband bank, and which character actually earned each account-wide achievement.
First release: the roster, and the groundwork for runs.
